## Bio

My path to Cardozo Law started with a love of problem-solving and building models that turn complex information into actionable insights. However, the more time I spent in financial markets, the more I found myself drawn to the rules, contracts, and regulatory frameworks that shape what happens on the desk in the first place.

Over the past few years, I've seen the technical side of markets through internships in fixed income trading, portfolio analytics, and quant trading, applying coding and analytical skills to financial data. Those experiences sparked my interest in securities and regulatory law now: I want to understand not just how markets work, but how the legal and compliance structures around them are enforced.

Outside of work and academics, I'm endlessly curious about the world: I love reading about economics, running, and strategy games like chess and poker! I created this website as a space to share my projects and experiences, and I hope it gives a sense of both my professional journey and the curiosity and creativity that drive me every day.
